notes: בְּלִי־שֵׁם → *of base men* is retained as `noncompositional`: neither morpheme's lexeme is written in the English, so rule 6's first-token fallback supplies the source head; heading the target on *base* was available (rule 8). The *of* is the chain's relation and belongs with the rectum (rule 19).
The Hebrew gloss note (*men of no name*) corroborates the fused reading without deciding it (rule 38).
*They are* is kept with the nominal predicate as the construction's copula and required subject rather than split off as `added`.
